name: ASJ's Source
subtitle: Apps made easier
description: ASJTube and ASJTok for AltStore and SideStore: the builds without app extensions.

apps.name: ASJTube (No Plugins)
apps.subtitle: Ad-free playback, background audio and downloads for YouTube
apps.localizedDescription:
This is an original version, it has YouTube's original bundle ID. Delete the original YouTube before installing. It has Plugins/Extensions removed so it can be signed with any certificate, including a free Apple ID.

Downloads, background audio and an ad-free YouTube — without changing how the app looks.

Everything lives in one place: an ASJTube tab in YouTube's own bar.

Requires iOS 17.0 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- Every menu, message and dialog is the app's own now. Same look, same place, same wording as YouTube.
- Downloads report the way YouTube reports its own — a notification at the bottom, and rows at the top of My library.
- Opening a YouTube link from Safari no longer closes the app.
- General improvements and fixes.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: This lets you add your own audio files to your videos.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: YouTube needs bluetooth access to scan for nearby Cast devices.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: This lets you create videos using the app.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Your contacts will be sent to YouTube servers to help you find friends to share videos with.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Access to your network allows YouTube to discover and connect to devices such as your TV.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This enables local content discovery, improved recommendations, and enhanced search results.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This lets you include audio with your videos and search using your voice.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This lets you upload media you've already created.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: To personalize ads and provide ad measurement, YouTube will link activity from this app with activity from non-Google apps and websites.

apps.name: ASJTok (No Plugins)
apps.subtitle: Privacy, download and playback options for TikTok
apps.localizedDescription:
This is an original version, it has TikTok's original bundle ID. Delete the original TikTok before installing. It has Plugins/Extensions removed so it can be signed with any certificate, including a free Apple ID.

Privacy, download and playback options for TikTok.

Open it from its own row in the profile menu, under ASJ tools at the end of TikTok's own list. Its options are in the long-press menu too. Requires iOS 15.0 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- ASJTikTok is now ASJTok. Same tweak, same settings.
- Change the app icon. Four icons, including ASJTok's own — in the IPA and TrollStore builds.
- Opens like TikTok's own settings. From the profile menu, with a back arrow and a swipe back.
- Audio files sent back to back are fixed. The second one could go out as a microphone recording.
- Send the sound of a video from Photos. Next to Files, behind the chat bar button.
- Marking a story as seen is instant. The ring turns grey right away, and stories you didn't mark stay unseen.
- The video count is back on profiles.
- Hide the ASJ button or TikTok's Tako button. Two new switches in Feed settings.
- General improvements and fixes.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This will allow "TikTok" to find and connect to Bluetooth accessories. This app may also use Bluetooth to connect with nearby devices.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: This will allow "TikTok" to find and connect to Bluetooth accessories. This app may also use Bluetooth to connect with nearby devices.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Add events to your device calendar to get reminders when events start.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: You'll be able to record video.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Sync your contacts to easily find people you know on TikTok. Your contacts will only be used to help you connect with friends.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: We'll use this to unlock features that require added security.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: The TikTok app will be able to discover and connect with devices that have the TikTok app installed for camera and screen sharing.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: If location services are enabled, TikTok will collect, store and use your device's approximate location to improve your experience.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: To record audio, allow us to access your Microphone.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: To upload from or download to your device, allow access to your photos in your phone settings.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To upload from or download to your device, allow access to your photos in your phone settings.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This allows TikTok to provide you with a better ads experience.
